issues: The On Evolve search filter excludes the wrong name; it should exclude the base card identity name "Jeno, Levin Vanguard", not "Jeno, Levin Vanguard Evolved".
The startOfEnd ability is encoded as dealing 5 damage only to enemies, but the source says each other follower on the field; it should damage all other followers, not just enemy followers.

The startOfEnd ability is encoded as dealing 5 damage only to enemy followers, but the source says each other follower on the field; it should damage all other followers, then also deal 5 damage to each enemy leader, then draw a card.

The card is missing the onDiscard ability "you may put it into your EX area"; it should be encoded as an onDiscard optional move of this card to the EX area. Implement support for an optional self-move-to-EX-area on discard, e.g. onDiscard with moveSourceToExArea plus optional handling.

The On Evolve ability is stubbed with noop; it should actually let you optionally put an amulet that costs 2 or less from your hand onto your field. Implement a supported effect for playing/summoning an amulet from hand to field instead of noop.

The triggered healing ability uses timing onAllyFollowerEnter with a filter, but the source is "when an amulet is put onto your field"; this needs a trigger that can detect ally amulets entering the field, not only followers. Implement a generic onAllyCardEnter/onAllyFieldCardEnter trigger or equivalent.

The triggered healing ability incorrectly places the amulet filter at the ability level; with current reference there is no such ability-level filter field, so it is not faithfully encoded and should be represented by a supported trigger/filter structure once implemented.
The card incorrectly has "storm" in keywords; the source gives Storm only to each other Festive follower on your field, not to this card itself, so remove the printed storm keyword from this card.
The spell effects are encoded with timing passive, but they should resolve when the spell is played; use timing spell with conditional effects instead of passive.

The first condition is wrong: it checks for a named follower "Idolatry", but the source says "if there's an Idolatry card on your field," meaning any card with the Idolatry trait. Implement a condition for a trait-bearing card on your field, e.g. fieldTraitMin/count 1 that works for non-followers as needed.

The second condition is too narrow if implemented as follower-only namedFollowerOnFieldByName; it should check whether a card named "Lishenna, Omen of Destruction" is on your field, not necessarily only a follower. Implement a named card-on-field condition that is not follower-restricted, or otherwise support this card name check on any field card.
